tasks.goal: Create README.md and CONTRIBUTING.md for a hypothetical stream-batch CLI. README.md must contain Overview, Installation and Usage headings; CONTRIBUTING.md must contain Development Workflow, Testing and Code of Conduct headings. Also create config.json with exact stage names ingest, normalize and publish, each enabled, and maxRetries set to 3.

Create docs/auth.md, docs/storage.md and docs/observability.md. Each file must have an H1 title, a '## When to use' section, and a '## Steps' section containing at least three concrete bullet points appropriate to that topic.
